description: This Java class defines the DeleteSubject command used to delete a Subject from a Policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating the command, serializing/deserializing to/from JSON, and accessing command properties.

classes.name: DeleteSubject
classes.description: Final class representing the command to delete a Subject from a Policy Entry, including serialization, deserialization, and property accessors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteSubject command with PolicyId, Label, SubjectId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a DeleteSubject command from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the PolicyEntry associated with the Subject to delete.

methods.name: getSubjectId
methods.description: Returns the SubjectId of the Subject to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the Policy.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource related to this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's data to a JSON builder, respecting schema version.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteSubject with the specified DittoHeaders.
